messages:
emily: Heads-up — noticed a broken curl example in api-ref for POST /v1/chat/generate. The example sends `Content-Type: application/x-ndjson` and streams SSE, but the body is regular JSON and the model enum is wrong (`redwood-1` instead of `redwood/1`). Results in 415 + 400 in prod docs tests. I'll open a docs PR to fix the curl + add correct Python/Node snippets. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 :eyes:

ajay: thanks. can you paste the failing curl and the fix here? want to add a small integration test in examples-runner.

emily: failing curl:
```bash
curl -N -H "Content-Type: application/x-ndjson" -d '{"model":"redwood-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate
```
fix should be:
```bash
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood/1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate
```
and update python snippet to use `stream=True` and `model='redwood/1'`.

maria: I'll update the Python snippet in the SDK docs. Any preference for showing SSE vs chunked-streaming?

kevin: show SSE example (curl) and then a short `requests` streaming example for python. I can add an automated smoke test that hits the example and validates content-type is text/event-stream. @ajay please add the test harness change.

emily: PR link above has the proposed diffs. main points: model enum change, header fixes (Accept + Content-Type), and short note explaining why SSE needs Accept header so curl doesn't try to buffer. also fixed example response in docs (was a JSON array; now shows SSE event lines).

docs-bot: CI checks for docs/pr/1234 — build succeeded :white_check_mark:

ajay: lgtm. please add a one-liner in CHANGES.md noting docs regression for publishing.

maria: working on the python snippet update, will push in this PR.

kevin: I pushed test scaffold to branch in the repo, linking in PR review.
